bds.lede: Lawyers for Massachusetts mother who killed children argue new trial would violate double jeopardy rules

PLYMOUTH, Mass. (AP) — Lindsay Clancy returned to court Monday in a bid to dismiss the charges that she murdered her three young children.
Clancy’s trial in the strangulation deaths of her three young children ended in a jury deadlock that forced the judge to declare a mistrial in September.

Lindsay Clancy is due back in court on Monday for a hearing that could determine whether she will be retried for killing her three young children at her Massachusetts home in 2023 after a jury deadlocked at her first trial.
The Massachusetts mother, accused of murdering her three children, is expected back in court as she awaits a decision on whether her case will be retried.
